name: Nevada

default_limits.basis: NRS 484B.600(1)(e): 80 mph absolute max on any road; otherwise only the basic 'reasonable and proper' rule and posted limits. Nevada has no statutory unposted residential/urban default; 80 shown only for motorway/trunk.

fine.notes: Civil infraction since 2023. Fine capped at $20 per mph over (NRS 484B.600(5)); civil penalties generally capped at $500 (NRS 484A.7043). $10/mph is one county's schedule (Nye); courts set their own.

court_costs.notes: Courts add administrative assessments and fees; amounts vary by court. Misdemeanor (30+ over) assessment is $30-$120 by fine size (NRS 176.059).

points.notes: Per NAC 483.510. 12 points in 12 months = 6-month suspension. Rural daytime tickets up to 5-10 over on 60-80 mph roads: $25, no points (NRS 484B.617).

zones.school_zone: Fines doubled in school and pedestrian safety zones (NRS 484B.135/484B.363).

court.reason: 21+ over: 3+ demerit points; 12 points in a year suspends license.

arrest.offense: Speeding 30+ mph over the posted limit (misdemeanor)

trucks.notes: No statewide truck-specific statutory limit found; follow posted truck signs.
